gear.name: AIC Fieldwork
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer gain DMG Dealt +20% for all types of DMG, +10% DMG Reduction against all types of DMG, and Ultimate Gain Efficiency +10%.

gear.name: Basic
bonuses: 3pc: No Set Effects

gear.name: Miner α
bonuses: 3pc: No Set Effects

gear.name: Miner β
bonuses: 3pc: No Set Effects

gear.name: Miner γ
bonuses: 3pc: No Set Effects

gear.name: Redeemer
bonuses: 3pc: No Set Effects

gear.name: Rift Trekker
bonuses: 3pc: No Set Effects

gear.name: Roving MSGR
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Agility +50. When the wearer's HP is above 80%, Physical DMG +20%.

gear.name: Frontiers
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction +15%. After the wearer's skill recovers SP, the team gains DMG +16% for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

gear.name: Aburrey's Legacy
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Skill DMG +24%. When the wearer casts a battle skill, combo skill, or ultimate, the wearer gains ATK +5% for 15s. The buff from each of the three skill types is unique and does not stack with itself.

gear.name: Type 50 Yinglung
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's ATK +15%. When any operator in the team casts a battle skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of Yinglung's Edge that gives DMG +20% to the wearer's next combo skill. Yinglung's Edge can stack 3 time(s).

gear.name: Bonekrusha
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's ATK +15%. When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of Bonekrushing Smash that grants the wearer's next battle skill DMG Dealt +30%. Bonekrushing Smash can stack 2 time(s).

gear.name: Tide Surge
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Skill DMG Dealt +20%. After the wearer applies 2 or more stacks of Arts Infliction on the enemy, the wearer gains Arts DMG Dealt +35% for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

gear.name: Qingbo
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction +15%. When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains Skill DMG Dealt +20% (for every skill) for 15s. This effect can reach 2 stacks. Duration of each stack is counted separately.

gear.name: MI Security
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Critical Rate +5%. After the wearer scores a critical hit, the wearer gains ATK +5% for 5s. This effect can reach 5 stacks. At max stacks, grant an additional Critical Rate +5%. This effect cannot stack.

gear.name: Grizzled Edge
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's ATK +8%. When the wearer applies [[File:Crush icon.png|15px|link=]]Crush or [[File:Breach icon.png|15px|link=]]Breach, the wearer gains Physical DMG Dealt +[6% × Max number of [[File:Vulnerable icon.png|15px|link=]]Vulnerability stacks consumed from one enemy] for 20s. If the target already has [[File:Physical Susceptibility icon.png|15px|link=]]Physical Susceptibility, is Staggered, or has attached Originium Crystals, increase the aforementioned buff to 1.5 times. This buff cannot stack.

gear.name: Xiranflow
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's ATK +10%. Whenever the wearer consumes [[File:Electrification icon.png|15px|link=]]Electrification or [[File:Corrosion icon.png|15px|link=]]Corrosion, the wearer gains a number of buff stacks equal to the Status Level of the Arts Reaction consumed, with each buff stack giving Electric DMG Dealt and Nature DMG Dealt +15% for 25s. The number of buff stacks maxes out at 3 stacks. Duration of each stack is counted separately.

gear.name: Hot Work
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Arts Intensity +30. After the wearer applies [[File:Combustion icon.png|15px|link=]]Combustion, the wearer gains Heat DMG +50% for 10s. After the wearer applies [[File:Corrosion icon.png|15px|link=]]Corrosion, the wearer gains Nature DMG +50% for 10s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

gear.name: LYNX
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's HP Treatment Efficiency +20%. After the wearer gives HP treatment to an allied target, that target also gains 15% DMG Reduction against all types of DMG for 10s. If the said treatment exceeds the target's Max HP, the target gains 30% DMG Reduction against all types of DMG. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

gear.name: Swordmancer
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Stagger Efficiency Bonus +20%. After the wearer applies a Physical Status, the wearer also performs 1 hit that deals 250% ATK of Physical DMG and [10 Stagger]. Effect trigger cooldown: 15s.

gear.name: Æthertech
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's ATK +8%. After the wearer applies [[File:Vulnerable icon.png|15px|link=]]Vulnerability, the wearer gains Physical DMG +8% for 15s. This effect can reach 4 stacks. If the target already has 4 stack(s) of [[File:Vulnerable icon.png|15px|link=]]Vulnerability, the wearer gains an additional Physical DMG +16% for 10s. This effect cannot stack.

gear.name: Pulser Labs
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Arts Intensity +30. After the wearer applies [[File:Electrification icon.png|15px|link=]]Electrification, the wearer gains Electric DMG +50% for 10s. After the wearer applies [[File:Solidification icon.png|15px|link=]]Solidification, the wearer gains Cryo DMG +50% for 10s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

gear.name: Deep Rampart
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Arts DMG Dealt +16%. When the wearer applies Nature Burst or Cryo Burst, the wearer gains Arts Intensity +16 for 20s. Max stacks for this effect: 3. Duration of each stack is counted separately. Effect only triggers once every 0.1s.

gear.name: Armored MSGR
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Strength +50. When the wearer's HP is below 50%, the wearer gains 30% DMG Reduction against all types of DMG.

gear.name: AIC Heavy
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's HP +500. After the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer restores 100 HP. Effect trigger cooldown: 5s.

gear.name: Catastrophe
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Ultimate Gain Efficiency +20%. The wearer casts a battle skill, the action returns 50 SP. This effect only triggers 1 time per battle.

gear.name: Eternal Xiranite
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's HP +1000. After the wearer applies [[File:Amp icon.png|15px|link=]]Amp, [[File:Protect icon.png|15px|link=]]Protected, [[File:Susceptibility icon.png|15px|link=]]Susceptibility, or [[File:Weaken icon.png|15px|link=]]Weakened, other teammates gain DMG Dealt +16% for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

gear.name: Mordvolt Resistant
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Will +50. When the wearer's HP is below 50%, Treatment Effect +30%.

gear.name: Mordvolt Insulation
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's Intellect +50. When the wearer's HP is above 80%, Arts DMG +20%.

gear.name: AIC Light
bonuses: 3pc: Wearer's HP +500. After the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer gains ATK +20 for 5s.
